issues.issue: ending_cash is null, but ending_investments (172,548) is filled from the same statement and the governmental Cash line 145,129 is printed. The statement rolls forward fund balance, not cash, so null is defensible (the other Lyman years are also null). However, filling investments but not cash is inconsistent.
The Electric fund's 315,970 is probably purchased power (Purchased Power/Cost of Sales), not professional services. The label alone doesn't settle it. The same applies to detail[66].

detail[37]-[46] put the 'Other' department's spending in category other. By p4, that 82,546 is public safety 39,748 + culture/recreation 30,938 + economic development 11,860, so no single function fits. Category other is defensible but is a judgment call.
This could be detail_category highway allocation (a state highway incentive payment in the Street Fund).
